before.evidence: The fitted patterned dress has constructed shoulder edges and a garment-defined torso silhouette, viewed from an oblique low angle. Hip boundaries are not independently clear. The stepping stance and heels further prevent a reliable standing leg comparison.

after.evidence: The dress follows the torso and hips closely, supporting narrow-to-intermediate build and slight-to-moderate waist indentation along the side contours. Shaped shoulder caps prevent a reliable shoulder/hip comparison. The skirt conceals the leg origin, and heels plus the stepping pose prevent a leg-proportion judgment.

after.evidence: The close torso portion of the top and fitted jeans reveal a fuller build across the torso, hips and thighs. Flutter sleeves obscure shoulder extent. Hands and the wrapped lower edge of the top interrupt the waist relationship. The shifted stance and high heels prevent judging leg proportions.
